title: Triassic Park Waidring Steinplatte
highlights: Begehbare Aussichtsplattform in Korallenform 70 Meter über dem Abgrund
Interaktives Triassic Center mit Forscherstationen zur Erdgeschichte
Triassic Trail mit lebensgrossen Dinosauriern und faszinierenden Fossilien
Triassic Beach mit Sandstrand und Wasserlabyrinth auf über 1600 Metern
kurzbeschreibung: The Triassic Park on the Steinplatte Waidring invites families on an exciting journey back in time to 200 million years ago.
beschreibung:
Primeval Adventure in the Kitzbüheler Alpen

Where the striking limestone formations of the Steinplatte rise today, the primeval Tethysmeer stretched out around 200 million years ago. The Triassic Park Waidring brings this era to life for visitors of all ages. Along the Triassic Trail, hikers encounter life-sized dinosaur models and genuine fossils.

Spectacular Vistas and Spirit of Discovery

An absolute highlight is the cantilevered viewing platform shaped like a fan coral, offering breathtaking panoramic views. In the accessible Triassic Center, young and old explorers delve into the evolution of marine reptiles and can discover their own fossils through interactive play.
